source_scope: USDA NASS Quick Stats county annual yield responses acquired before model fitting
crop_variant_rule: commodity_desc + '__' + normalized class_desc; variants are never combined as one target.
population_rule: Select the sole crop variant with at least 500 county series having 10 or more observed train-period years (year <= 2018), zero conflicting canonical values, and the largest count of valid county-year records. Retain only those qualifying county series. This rule uses source coverage only, never model metrics or holdout performance.

split_rule.selection_rule: Tune only on train/validation. Do not alter this split after inspecting holdout metrics.

temporal_contract.rule: Only full-season weather ending no later than the target reference-year end may be joined. This is retrospective anomaly modeling, not an in-season forecast claim.
